model_updates: HeadlessSession - Change primary responsibility to single entry point: Remove multiple public methods exposing internals, Add 'Invokes with message and context file: ExecutionResult, Message, ContextFile', Keep internal responsibilities as private implementation details
ExecutionContext - Should be owned by HeadlessSession: 'Loads from context file' becomes internal to HeadlessSession, Public interface only exposes what HeadlessSession needs
Instructions - Should be internal to HeadlessSession: All preparation methods become internal, Not exposed to caller
SessionLog - Should be owned by HeadlessSession: Creation and management internal, Only log path returned in result
